subject: Working w/ Figure, 1x & PI | Skild Brain
text:
Hi [NAME]​, 

I've been following Skild's focus on RL approaches to Physical AI for a while & thought I'd reach out. I lead a Robotics team here at Encord and we're working w/ a few of your peers (1X, Figure AI, Physically Intelligence, Archetype, etc) to support the fine-tuning of their VLMs / VLAs - particularly focused on using Agentic workflows to speed up the generation of caption diversity within HITL verification flows.

Keen to trade notes & get your thoughts on what we're building if you're be open to a 30-minute chat this week or the next? Wednesdays and Thursdays usually work for me.

subject: Working w/ Captions & Synthesia | State of Marketing & AI report
text:
Hi [NAME]​, 

I just read [COMPANY]'s State of Marketing & AI report-it looks like GenAI (text-to-image, text-to-video, multimodal AI, etc.) is a strategic focus for [YEAR]. We collaborate closely with GenAI marketing teams at Synthesia, Flawless AI, and Captions to enhance the quality of their multimodal AI models through post-training flows like RLHF with Likert scales, advanced multimodal data curation, and active learning.

I've been following (and using) [COMPANY] for a while, so I'd love to chat and get your candid feedback on what we're building here at Encord. Would you be open to a quick 20-minute catch-up in the coming weeks? Wednesdays and Thursdays work best for me.

subject: Met Margaret & Victoria | Working w/ Captions & Synthesia
text:
Hi [NAME]​, 

I recently met Margaret & Victoria from your team who mentioned the team's might be using Labelbox. We actually work closely with Synthesia & Captions who moved over from LB to improve the quality of their multimodal AI models.

We're seeing more sophisticated teams turning to us to advance model training with post-training flows like RLHF using Likert scales or curating multimodal data. Thought this could be relevant to your work on the Multilingual / Scribe models. 

Keen to chat either way and get your candid feedback on what we're building here at Encord. Would you be open to a quick 20 mins catch up in the coming weeks? Wednesdays and Thursdays work best for me.

subject: Physical AI Panel - Apr 15 - Nuro & Motive attending
text:
Hi [NAME],

Heard great things about your leadership of the ADAS perception team! We're
hosting an intimate Physical AI event with Next47 on Tuesday April 15th at
AWS Loft in SF (capping attendance at 40). We'd love for you to join if

subject: [Invitation] Dîner Leaders IA à Paris
text:
Bonjour [NAME]​, 

Notre co-fondateur organise un dîner intime avec des clients et des leaders de l'IA à Paris, et nous serions ravis de vous y inviter.

Les participants sont des CEO, CTO, Directeurs de Computer Vision et VP IA de start-ups comme Jellysmack, ProovStation, Veesion, etc. Ce dîner privé aura lieu le 21 mai au restaurant Maison de l'Amérique Latine, où nous avons réservé un salon privatisé pour environ 20 personnes, à partir de 19h.

Si vous ne connaissez pas encore Encord, nous avons levé 50M$ auprès de CRV et Y Combinator. Nous proposons une plateforme de développement de données end-to-end pour les équipes ML/IA, utilisée notamment par Axa, EuroControl, Moon Surgical, etc. Nous unifions la gestion des données, leur visualisation et leur annotation au sein d'une seule et même solution.

Merci de bien vouloir confirmer votre présence à cette invitation si vous souhaitez réserver votre place - les places sont limitées et attribuées selon le principe du premier arrivé, premier servi.
